Xcode.Xcode3ProjectSupport.Xcode3Capabil.target: Set App Transport Security exceptions to allow your app to make insecure connections to specified domains.
Enables a testing mode in fileproviderd. This provides control over the timing of operations and allows programmatic triggering of all possible orderings.
Support for SCSI controller drivers.
Wallet gives users a way to organize passes, tickets, gift cards, credit cards and loyalty cards. Use the PassKit framework APIs to display, add, or update items in your users' Wallets.
Enabling Extended Virtual Addressing allows you to use more address space in your app.
Allows an app to claim links shared in Messages conversations and for them to be surfaced to it via the Shared with You Framework.
AutoFill Credential Provider allows your app, with user permission, to provide user names and passwords for AutoFill into apps and Safari.

Hardened Runtime defends your application by preventing modifications to its code and provides fine-grained controls over what can run in your process. Hardening the runtime also prevents access to sensitive resources unless your application pre-declares its intent to use them, which reduces the attack surface by eliminating unnecessary access. These properties help prevent exploitation of your application and this capability is required for your app to be notarized.
Allows this application to share passwords from its keychain with other applications made by your team.

With MapKit, you can create routing apps that users can access from Maps. Your apps can provide specific directions beyond what the Maps app supports, including subway routes, hiking trails, or bike paths.
Support for serial family drivers.
Enabling Access Wi-Fi Information allows your app to obtain information about the currently connected Wi-Fi network
Enabling Personal VPN allows your app to create and control a custom system VPN configuration.

Data protection allows applications that work with sensitive user data to take advantage of the built-in encryption available on some devices. When your application designates a specific file as protected, the system stores that file on-disk in an encrypted format.
Support for HID device family drivers.
Support for networking family drivers.
Allows access to group containers that are shared among multiple related apps, and allows certain additional interprocess communication between the apps.
Enabling Sign in with Apple allows your users to authenticate with their Apple ID.
Allows an app to be associated with a specified domain for specific services such as accessing Safari saved passwords and activity continuation.

Time Sensitive notifications deliver information that demand immediate attention and directly call on the individual to take action in the moment they receive them. Time Sensitive alerts are always delivered immediately, surfaced above other notifications, and allowed to break through Focus and Do Not Disturb.

iCloud Storage APIs enable your apps to store data and documents in iCloud, keeping your apps up to date automatically. Use iCloud to give your users a consistent and seamless experience across iCloud-enabled devices.
The MapKit framework provides an interface for embedding maps directly into the views and windows of your app.
Allows communication between an app and DriverKit drivers.

Background Modes specifies that the app provides specific background services and must be allowed to continue running while in the background. These keys should be used sparingly and only by apps providing the indicated services. Where alternatives for running in the background exist, those alternatives should be used instead.
Allows apps to pass setup code information to pair Matter accessories to their ecosystem or Apple Home without having to scan a QR code.
Enabling Wireless Accessory Configuration allows your app to configure MFi Wi-Fi accessories.
Enabling Hotspot Configuration allows your app to configure Wi-Fi networks.
Enabling Inter-App Audio allows your app to send audio to and receive audio from other Inter-App Audio-enabled apps.

Family Controls enables your app for parental controls, granting access to the Managed Settings and Device Activity frameworks in the Screen Time API. Use of Family Controls requires Family Sharing for user enrollment. It prevents removal of your app and allows on-device content filters from Network Extensions.
Support for USB transport drivers.
Increased Memory Limit enables your app to exceed the default app memory limit on supported devices.
With App Attest, you can generate a special cryptographic key on device and use it to validate the integrity of your app before your server provides access to sensitive data.
Enabling HomeKit allows your app to interact with HomeKit accessories and create home configurations.
Enabling System Extension allows your app to install its associated system extensions.
Identifies this target as an app clip extension.
Enabling HealthKit allows your app, with user permission, to store and retrieve personal health information.
Support for audio family drivers.
Enables DriverKit development.
Game Center allows players to connect to the Game Center service, enabling them to interact with their friends, view leader boards, or play head to head in your game.
Support for HID transport drivers.
Support for HID event service family drivers.
Enabling Network Extensions allows you to create app extensions that extend and customize the networking capabilities of your device.
WeatherKit provides current and forecasted weather information.

In-App Purchase lets you sell a variety of items directly within your free or paid app, including premium content, virtual goods, and subscriptions.

Enables your app to report Push to Talk channels to the system so that it can handle transmitting and receiving audio in the background.
Add support for game controllers to your app.
Allows your app to support initiating collaboration using Messages.
Fonts allows your app, with user permission, to install and make use of custom fonts.
Allows MDM to supplement the Associated Domains that are included with your app with values such as server names that are unique for an environment.
Apple Pay allows users to easily and securely pay for physical goods and services such as groceries, clothing, tickets, and reservations in apps using payment information stored in their device.

Apple Push Notification service is a robust and highly efficient service for propagating information to devices.
Allows apps to send notifications for communication from a person to a person or persons.
Enabling Custom Network Protocol allows your app to use custom network protocols that run on top of Internet Protocol, or use custom network protocols that run on top of the network link layer.
Near Field Communication Tag Reading allows your app to read NDEF formatted NFC tags.
Driver is allowed to communicate with 3rd party user clients.
In-App Purchase lets you sell a variety of items directly within your free or paid app, including premium content, virtual goods, and subscriptions.
Allows your application to handle Siri requests.
Allows for the integration of 3rd party media casting protocols into iOS system UI through an application extension that handles custom protocol discovery.

Allows an app to communicate with the same app on one or more other devices to create a group activity within a FaceTime call. Group Activities on FaceTime lets users watch video together, listen to music together, or enjoy another synchronous activity.

Enabling ClassKit allows your app to privately and securely share student progress with teachers on activities assigned, like reading a chapter in a book, completing a set of math equations or taking a quiz, in school-managed environments.
Enabling User Management allows your app or app extension to discover the current user of the system and automatically switch to a user’s preferred settings within your app.
Multipath allows your app to use multipath protocols like Multipath TCP which will seamlessly hand over traffic from one interface to another.

App Sandbox employs services of the operating system to create a barrier between your application code and critical user data, network access, or other processes on the system. The sandbox helps to minimize risks from insecure code in your app, or in frameworks you link against.
